{{Short description|Indian-American statistician}}
'''Moulinath (Mouli) Banerjee'''<ref name="umich" /> (born 1974) is an Indian statistician at the [[University of Michigan]].

== Education and career ==
Banerjee completed his bachelor's and master's in statistics at the [[Indian Statistical Institute]] in 1995 and 1997, respectively,<ref name="umich"/> then authored a doctoral dissertation, ''Likelihood Ratio Inference in Regular and Nonregular Problems'' in 2000, advised by [[Jon A. Wellner]] of the [[University of Washington]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy}}</ref> Banerjee remained in Washington as a lecturer until joining the [[University of Michigan]] faculty in 2001.<ref name="umich">{{cite news |title=Moulinath Banerjee |url=https://lsa.umich.edu/stats/people/faculty/moulib.html |access-date=13 August 2023 |publisher=University of Michigan}}</ref> 

== Research ==
Banerjee's research interests comprise non-standard statistical models, shape-constrained methods, [[empirical process theory]], [[distributed computing]], and [[Meta-learning (computer science)|meta-learning]]. Apart from his statistical pursuits, he takes an avid interest in classical music, [[fine dining]], literature, and philosophy, and together with a co-author has published a [https://www.amazon.com/Rubaiyat-Revisited-Moulinath-Banerjee-ebook/dp/B09P4GV6LY new translation] of the [[Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam]] from the original Persian. Banerjee married the economist Debasri Mukherjee in July 2004 and the couple welcomed their only child and the family's only grandchild, Vedantika Banerjee, on October 14, 2009. 

== Honors and awards ==
In 2017, Banerjee was elected a fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics|Institute of Mathematical Statistics (IMS)]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Professor Moulinath Banerjee named IMS Fellow |url=https://lsa.umich.edu/stats/news-events/all-news/facultynews/BanerjeeIMSFellow.html |access-date=13 August 2023 |publisher=University of Michigan |date=3 May 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=2017 IMS Fellows |url=https://imstat.org/2017/05/15/2017-ims-fellows-2/ |access-date=13 August 2023 |publisher=Institute of Mathematical Statistics |date=15 May 2017}}</ref> The following year, the [[American Statistical Association]] elected him to an equivalent honor.<ref>{{cite news |title=Moulinath Banerjee has been selected as a Fellow of the American Statistical Association |url=https://lsa.umich.edu/stats/news-events/all-news/facultynews/moulinath-banerjee-has-been-selected-as-a-fellow-of-the-american.html |access-date=13 August 2023 |publisher=University of Michigan |date=13 April 2018}}</ref> Banerjee will deliver one of the prestigious [https://imstat.org/ims-special-lectures/honored-special-lecturers-recipient-list/ IMS Medallion Lectures] in 2024 and is serving as Editor of IMS's primary review journal, [https://imstat.org/journals-and-publications/statistical-science/ Statistical Science], from 2023 to 2025.
